entities.title: JSON request and reply protocol
entities.summary: The request objects the library accepts and the reply fields callers act on, through `zazzle call` and the MCP tool zazzle_call.
consumers: Coding agents, through MCP or a shell, guided by agents/skills/zazzle/SKILL.md
Developers' shells and scripts using `zazzle call`
The daemon (src/macos/daemon/src/cmd/call.rs), which passes requests and replies through unchanged
guarantees: A request is an object whose `op` is read, search (alias find), list (alias ls), stat, outline or diff_since; unknown ops and unknown fields are rejected. An array of requests gets an array of replies in the same order.
Every reply carries `ok`; a failure is {"ok": false, "error": <message>}.
Line numbers and ranges are 1-based and inclusive.
An etag is `b3:` followed by the first 16 hex digits (64 bits) of the content's BLAKE3 hash; equal etags mean equal content.

Within a session, replies of read, search, list, outline and diff_since that carry content also carry a `ref` (r1, r2, … per session); a repeat already received is {etag, unchanged: true, ref} with the earlier ref, and `fresh: true` always sends content. Without a session there is no memory.
A diff reply carries changed: true, base_etag and hunks of {at, del, new_at, ins}: at is the 1-based old line, del the old lines removed, ins the new text (absent for a pure deletion).
A capped reply carries truncated with next_ranges and bytes_omitted (read) or next_cursor (list); outline and search say truncated.
entities.compatibility: Not stated; waiting on the owner (decisions.json, protocol-compatibility).

entities.title: Library interface to the daemon
entities.summary: What the daemon calls and implements: Engine::call(session, Ctx {cwd, host}, request), Engine::forget_prefix, list::stat and the Host trait (files, dirs, search, outline).
guarantees: Host::files returns regular files sorted; Host::search returns only files with matches, in the given order, with 1-based columns; Host::outline returns one entry per file, None for a file without an outline.
Engine::call never panics on bad input; it answers with ok false.
entities.compatibility: Internal to the repository: change both crates in one commit.
